verified.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
verified.note: The tested DXGI loader route stopped at DX12 error 0x80004004. Removing the loader allowed gameplay but lost OptiScaler upscaling and did not confirm FG. Alternate loader selection requires a fresh game check.
verified.observed: DXGI loader caused DX12 startup error on tested build; bypass reached gameplay without confirmed FG, October 29, 2026

verified.title: CONTROL Resonant
verified.note: Hangs at the Remedy logo while the XeFG swap chain is created unless the game's DLSS Frame Generation is on: DLSS FG input plus m_eDLSSFGMode 1 in renderer.ini (created by the game on first start).

verified.title: Crimson Desert
verified.note: FSR 3.1 FG input with the game's frame generation on (native Anti-Lag 2), although the game also ships XeSS FG.

verified.title: Cyberpunk 2077
verified.note: Cyberpunk 2.5: DLSS upscaling and DLSS frame-generation input to XeFG. Keep the game's own libxess.dll and disable XeSS upscaler input. This combination passed with HelixSR; native XeSS FG with DLSS/HelixSR did not generate in these checks. Native AMD Anti-Lag 2 is disabled for this DLSS route, matching the working FG profile. Reflex is enabled, matching the game's DLSS FG behavior without adding a frame-rate cap. With HelixSR, disable the reactive/bias mask input as a workaround for intermittent first-frame GPU faults; this removes a temporal-reconstruction input. Switching to FSR 4 returns this recipe-owned setting to its original value. Explicit user settings are preserved. HLX FSR 4 HDR also requires the tested reactive-mask-off workaround: the default produced a GPU page fault during startup. This changes an upscaler input; mask-on quality equivalence is unqualified.
verified.observed: 2.5 benchmark, HelixSR Quality, DLSS FG input: 2.0 in SDR and HDR10

verified.title: Dead as Disco
verified.note: FSR FG input generates only with the game's own frame generation on (FrameGenerationMode). FSR FG input generates only with the game's FSR frame generation on; FrameGenerationMode was Off (accident).

manual_steps: In the game, choose FSR and Native mode. The tested upscaler input requires matching motion/depth dimensions; Quality failed on the tested build. Restart after changing the input.
verified.title: Deadzone: Rogue
verified.note: Use FSR Native in the game. FSR Quality produced incompatible motion/depth dimensions (XeFG status -4). Native changes the rendering workload; the installer does not silently change quality.
verified.observed: 2× generated presents in two gameplay starts on October 29, 2026; FSR Native input

manual_steps: Enable DLSS upscaling and DLSS Frame Generation in the game, then restart.
verified.title: Deep Rock Galactic
verified.note: Enable DLSS upscaling and DLSS Frame Generation in the game, then restart. An unselected reward screen can prevent reaching gameplay.
verified.observed: Sustained 2× generated presents in the Space Rig after a fresh restart, October 29, 2026

manual_steps: Story Mode only, with BattlEye disabled using the game launcher option (-nobattleye).
Restore FreeFG before playing GTA Online: without -nobattleye, OptiScaler stays inactive (RequireArgument), but its DLL still loads beside BattlEye.
Select DLSS in the game (Quality was tested); leave the game's frame generation off. FreeFG enables XeFG through OptiFG.
Use the bundled OptiScaler ba0dedb or a descendant (Social Club factory fix, RequireArgument); leave DxgiFactoryWrapping at auto/false and remove any SocialClubD3D12Renderer DLL-disable override.
verified.title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
verified.note: GTA 1.0.1158.16, GE-Proton11-11, AMD FSR 4 RC12. The anti-cheat installation refusal still requires explicit per-game acceptance. The Social Club overlay stays available.
verified.observed: Story Mode bank prologue, movement and Social Club open/close; sustained 2.0 generated presents per game frame, including a fresh start with XeFG enabled and starts with RequireArgument unset and set to -nobattleye

manual_steps: Select DLSS Quality and DLSS Frame Generation in the game, then verify both after restarting. The tested game rewrote FG to Off; do not assume the saved setting took effect.
verified.title: Hogwarts Legacy
verified.note: The game can reset DLSS FG to Off on startup. One gameplay run generated 2×, but setting persistence is unresolved. Check the menu after restarting; installation integrity alone does not confirm FG.
verified.observed: 2× in opening gameplay with DLSS Quality and DLSS FG; repeat-launch persistence unresolved, October 29, 2026

verified.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
verified.note: OptiFG input; HUDLimit 1 is kept for the OptiScaler menu's HUDFix toggle (HUDFix itself stays off).

verified.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
verified.note: The tested launch stopped at Rockstar authentication error 2 even directly through Heroic. Resolve launcher authentication before diagnosing FreeFG.
verified.observed: Rockstar authentication error 2 prevented game qualification, October 29, 2026

verified.title: RoboCop: Rogue City
verified.note: FSR FG input needs the game's AMD frame generation; the game's FSR 3.0 FG may not reach OptiScaler. RoboCop's own FSR 3.0 frame generation never reaches OptiScaler (FSR FG input: 1.0 in gameplay even with the FSR upscaler); DLSS upscaling with the game's DLSS frame generation feeds XeFG through DLSS FG input (OptiPatcher exposes DLSS without spoofing).

verified.title: System Shock
verified.note: DX12 via -dx12 (the default DX11 path does not reach the upscaler).

verified.title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
verified.note: FSR, DLSS and DXGI-spoof trials supplied no upscaler input on the tested build. No verified recipe fix. Preserve saves and graphics preferences during diagnosis.
verified.observed: No upscaler creation or generated frames in the tested gameplay, October 29, 2026

verified.title: Thymesia
verified.note: Needs an in-game resolution scale above 100% for the upscaler to run; DX12 via -dx12.

verified.title: Witchfire
verified.note: DLSS FG input; the game's DLSS_FG setting is turned on.
